facts.statement: The holotype fossil CLGRP V00013 was discovered in 2016 in Pu'an town, Yunyang County, Chongqing.
facts.quote: After the discovery of a new quarry from the Shaximiao Formation in 2016, the holotype of Yuzhoulong, CLGRP V00013, was discovered in Pu'an town in Yunyang County in Chongqing.

facts.statement: Dai and colleagues named the genus and species Yuzhoulong qurenensis in 2022.
facts.quote: It was named as a distinct genus and species by Dai et al. in 2022.

facts.statement: Yuzhoulong is a macronarian sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic of Chongqing, China, named after the ancient name for the region.
facts.quote: Yuzhoulong (meaning "Chongqing dragon", after Yuzhou, an early name for Chongqing) is a genus of macronarian sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic Shaximiao Formation of Chongqing, China.

facts.statement: The known remains consist of a partial skeleton with a partial skull belonging to an immature subadult individual.
facts.quote: Yuzhoulong is only known from a partial skeleton, including a partial skull, of an immature subadult individual.

facts.statement: The fossil was found partially buried in rock mixed with fossils of another unnamed sauropod species.
facts.quote: It was partially buried in the rock at the time of its description, mixed in with the fossils of another, unnamed sauropod.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses consistently classify Yuzhoulong as a basal macronarian.
facts.quote: In 2022, Dai et al. added Yuzhoulong to a number of different phylogenetic analyses, which consistently recovered as it a basal macronarian.

facts.statement: Yuzhoulong lived during the Middle Jurassic in the Shaximiao Formation of Chongqing, China.
facts.quote: Yuzhoulong (meaning "Chongqing dragon", after Yuzhou, an early name for Chongqing) is a genus of macronarian sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic Shaximiao Formation of Chongqing, China.

facts.statement: The time range for Yuzhoulong is estimated to be between 168.2 and 161.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Callovian (168.2 to 161.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: Yuzhoulong belongs to the parent group Macronaria.
Yuzhoulong is classified within the class Saurischia.

rejected.statement: The existence of Yuzhoulong proves that macronarians existed by at least the Middle Jurassic, suggesting higher diversity of neosauropods in that era.
rejected.quote: This proves that macronarians existed by at least the Middle Jurassic, indicating a higher diversity of neosauropods in this age.
